title: Growth Rate of 3-Uniform Hypergraph Ramsey Numbers
exact_target: How fast must a set grow before every two-colouring of its triples forces a large monochromatic subset, and is a double-exponential lower bound necessary?

sources.citation: Dubroff, Girao, Hurley, and Yap, Tower Gaps in Multicolour Ramsey Numbers, Forum of Mathematics, Sigma (2023), introduction.
